title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode9 The Team's All Here!

rows.Line: Tsukasa's Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And then, I make my grand appearance!
Yes, this is a pretty good storyline.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Are you writing a new play, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I am! My troupe is working on our first show. I'm making a rough draft of the script.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's so cool! When is the play? I'd love to see it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've got it scheduled for the first day of the school break, starting at noon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh no, I'm working on that day.
I'm so sad I'll miss it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh right, I keep forgetting you got that cafe job. And you also joined a school club? Are you sure you can handle all that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Of course! No problem!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Although I'll be more careful not to overdo things, so that I don't worry everyone again...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I am Pegasus, prince of this land!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: T-Tsukasa, what are you saying?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “My journey to defeat the dastardly demon lord has only just begun. It will certainly be rife with peril, but at the end of it, surely, there is hope!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “The strength of my conviction banished all fear from my heart!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
!!
Hehe, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You've always been doing performances for me, ever since we were little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You'd make my plushies characters in your plays, remember? My bunny plushie often got the leading role.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A bunny plushie? I'm not sure I recall using that one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It got terribly worn out from all those imaginary adventures, but I loved seeing it in your plays!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I hope your new show turns out great!
Seeing you doing what you enjoy makes me happy too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can be sure it will be phenomenal!
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Guys! I've finished writing the script for our very first performance!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You wrote it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and I can tell you that it does me great justice, putting me in a role perfect for a brilliant star!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Hmm. If this is your masterpiece, it should reveal how smart you actually are.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... Always trying to pick a fight with me, huh? Well, I'm sorry if you don't understand the script, but I'm not going to bother explaining it to you!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: That's fine, your explanations would only make it worse.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They've really taken to each other♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. They're unusually well-matched.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have one more important announcement to make!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The name for our troupe!
If we're going to stage official performances, we must have a name!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That is a good point. What did you have in mind?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ahem...
The Pegasus Soaring in the Sky Troupe!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Wow, that sucks.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What did you say?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What could you possibly not like about it?
It oozes stylishness!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, it's not easy to explain what exactly makes it uncool, but I think most of us can agree that...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: It just sucks.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How rude, dismissing a name I spent so much time coming up with! But if you're so clever, do YOU have any suggestions?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, let's ask around. Emu, what name would you propose?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... How about... Sunshine World Sunny Funny Power? Or, Flower World Blooming Blossom Parade?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Those sound more like kids' TV shows.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why do you have to have “world” in every name?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's because the Wonder Stage becomes different worlds during shows!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It can be a jungle world, or a world above the clouds, or a prehistoric world, or an alien planet!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's a wonderland that can be anything you dream of! Every time the curtain rises, a new adventure begins, and it makes everyone in the audience happy and excited!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... Why don't we go with that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We could base our name on Emu's wish that everyone has a great time watching the stories played out in the wonderland of the stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mhm... “A Great Time in the Wonderland”?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Maybe... Instead of great time, it can be “showtime”?
Then we can put it together as... Wonderland Showtime?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ooh, that sounds cool!
I'll write our new name on the script!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No! Hang on!
This name has got nothing on The Pegasus Soaring in the Sky!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There, I wrote it! Wonderlands×Showtime!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, why did you put an x there? And why is it plural?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You see, it's because every new show creates a new wonderland, so they multiply!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Besides, it looks cooler that way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, it doesn't...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... It's not bad, actually.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I have no objections either.
Sometimes going with your first thought is best.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But not my first thought, huh... *Sigh*... Well, the shows themselves are more important than the name of the troupe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: At least we have a name now, so we can move on to preparing for our first performance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Let's do this, everyone☆
